entities.summary: Khadija al-Salami is the first Yemeni female film producer and director. Al-Salami currently resides in Paris, France. She has been nominated and also won awards at film festivals such as the Dubai International Film Festival and Vesoul Asian Film Festival. Her semi-autobiographical 2014 film, I Am Nojoom, Age 10 and Divorced was submitted to the Academy Awards, but was not selected.
